rule: The PM tool (Surge Command) is home base: it is the single location where all lanes add all projects, where the client submits and watches work, and where completed work enters the Output Ledger. No lane works off board.

projects.title: Make a call list from the recall report I approved for patients due this month.
projects.first_step: Open this project in the PM tool, confirm the approved source material for the work with the champion, and begin with the first item on the list.
projects.definition_of_done: The finished work is checked against the source material, recorded in the PM tool and in the memory work log, and the result is visible to the client in the PM tool.
projects.source: Business Type Pack starter request, in the client's words
